description: Captured from `node extension/server.mjs` on a temp DB (LLMIDE_DB_PATH in TMPDIR, LLMIDE_ENGINE_PREWARM=0), replayed over HTTP and seeded through the API. Another user sends an existing plan id; the ownership check inside savePlan throws and the route answers 500 SAVE_FAILED.
